name: find-repeats
description:
Words that repeat an earlier word of the phrase (find and remove; remove keeps the first one).

mode: "exact" — the same word (case and ё do not count, punctuation does: «диван, диван» has no repeat); "wordforms" — the same lemma.
scope: "all" words; only "adjacent" repeats («диван диван»); only words with a latin ("en") or a cyrillic ("ru") letter («iphone13», «wi-fi-роутер»); only "numbers" («2», «1,5»).

Example: semkit read --text "диван купить диван" --text "кресло" find-repeats write -
-> диван купить диван, true; кресло, false

find-repeats marks the rows where the matcher finds something, in a new column <column>_find of true and false.

options.name: --mode
options.description: "exact" — the same word (case and ё do not count, punctuation does: «диван, диван» has no repeat); "wordforms" — the same lemma.

options.name: --scope
options.description: "all" words; only "adjacent" repeats («диван диван»); only words with a latin ("en") or a cyrillic ("ru") letter («iphone13», «wi-fi-роутер»); only "numbers" («2», «1,5»).

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
